title: "Repository layout"
toc: true
number-sections: false

Keep this map in sync with the package after any structural change (new or moved
modules).

```text
src/collekt/
  __init__.py              # public API: Request, Region, Fetcher, Result,
                           #   Assembler, run_doctor, DoctorCheck
  version.py               # single version source (bumped by commitizen)

  core/
    request.py             # Region, Request, datetime/sampling parsing
    temporal.py            # SamplingPlan + per-source timestamp planning
    naming.py              # filename/request-dir patterns + bbox hashing
    collect.py             # run_collection orchestration (adapter dispatch)
    fetcher.py             # Fetcher workflow (check / plan / download / export)
    result.py              # Result
    manifest.py            # manifest builder + post-fetch inspection
    reporting.py           # Summary, summarize, CliReporter
    availability.py        # coverage checks (declarative + online describe)
    doctor.py              # environment / configuration diagnostics
    exporting.py           # directory / zip exports
    geo.py                 # bbox maths (geopy) + GeoJSON -> WKT (shapely)
    credentials.py         # environment credential resolution
    config/
      loader.py            # layered YAML load, preset merge, env expansion
      schema.py            # typed Config / SourceConfig / ... + variable resolution

  sources/
    base.py                # adapter protocol + registry, SourceResult/status
    planning.py            # shared dry-run planner (plan_source, coverage)
    cmems.py               # copernicusmarine.subset               (open)
    ecmwf_open_data.py     # forecast wind, GRIB2                   (open)
    era5.py                # reanalysis wind, cdsapi                (credentials)
    copernicus_dataspace.py# Sentinel/Landsat product files        (credentials)
    skytruth.py            # oil-slick features -> Parquet          (open)
    hozint.py              # threat-intel reports -> Parquet        (credentials)
    eodyn.py               # eOdyn ocean-data (archive/api)         (credentials)
    skytruth.spec.yaml     # Skytruth column metadata (damast spec)

  assemble/
    gridded.py             # Assembler: regrid + time-align -> xarray/NetCDF/Zarr/NumPy

  conf/
    default.yaml           # output / cache / credential-path defaults

  resources/
    schema/manifest.schema.json   # draft manifest schema (reference; not enforced)
    regions/                      # example region GeoJSON files

  cli/
    main.py                # `collekt fetch` / `doctor` / `config show`
```

Source catalogs (`source/*.yaml`) and curated presets (`preset/*.yaml`) are
supplied by the caller through a configuration directory (`--conf-dir`); collekt
ships the loading mechanism and the adapters, not a domain catalog.
